title: A2 yakuniy imtihon
goal_uz: Dars oxirida A2 darajasidagi grammatika, lug‘at, o‘qish, tinglash, yozish va gapirish topshiriqlarini imtihon strategiyasi bilan bajarasiz va bir daqiqalik hikoya aytib bera olasiz.

scenes.title: A2 yakuniy imtihon
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Bugun A2 darajasining yakuniy darsi. O‘tgan darsda e’lonlar va dialoglarni tinglashni mashq qildik. Bugun butun darajani takrorlaymiz: o‘tgan zamon, kelasi zamon, taqqoslash, present perfect, kundalik vaziyatlar va qisqa xabarlar. Imtihon strategiyasini o‘rganamiz, grammatika, lug‘at, o‘qish, tinglash, yozish va gapirish bo‘yicha sinov topshiriqlarini bajaramiz.
scenes.say: Welcome to the A2 exam lesson. Today we review everything and practise the exam tasks.
scenes.say_uz: A2 imtihon darsiga xush kelibsiz. Bugun hamma narsani takrorlaymiz va imtihon topshiriqlarini mashq qilamiz.

scenes.title: Imtihon qanday tuzilgan
scenes.say_native: A2 imtihoni odatda beshta qismdan iborat: grammatika va lug‘at, o‘qish, tinglash, yozish va gapirish. Hammasida oddiy, kundalik vaziyatlar bo‘ladi: do‘kon, yo‘l so‘rash, reja, xabar yozish. Murakkab so‘z yoki chiroyli uslub kerak emas. Aniq, to‘g‘ri va oddiy gap yetarli. Bugun har bir qism uchun qisqa sinov topshirig‘i bajaramiz.
scenes.say: The exam has five parts. Everything is simple and about daily life.
scenes.say_uz: Imtihon beshta qismdan iborat. Hammasi oddiy va kundalik hayot haqida.

scenes.title: Takrorlash: past simple

examples.t: I went to the market yesterday.
Did you see him? No, I didn't.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi takrorlash: past simple. Tugallangan va aniq vaqti bor voqea uchun. Muntazam fe’llarga ed qo‘shamiz, noto‘g‘rilarini yodlaymiz: go — went, see — saw, buy — bought. Inkor va savolda did ishlatiladi va fe’l asosiy shaklga qaytadi: didn’t go, did you see. Eng keng tarqalgan xato — “did you went”. Did dan keyin hech qachon ikkinchi shakl kelmaydi.
scenes.say: I went home. I didn't go out. Did you see him? Yes, I did.
scenes.say_uz: Men uyga bordim. Men chiqmadim. Uni ko‘rdingizmi? Ha.

scenes.title: Past simple mashqi
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Qavs ichidagi fe’llarni past simplega o‘tkazing. Birinchi: kecha men kitob sotib oldim. Ikkinchi: u darsga kelmadi. Uchinchi: siz filmni ko‘rdingizmi? Har gapni baland ovozda to‘liq ayting.
scenes.say: One. Yesterday I buy a book. Two. She not come to class. Three. You see the film?
scenes.say_uz: Bir. Kecha men kitob sotib oldim. Ikki. U darsga kelmadi. Uch. Filmni ko‘rdingizmi?

scenes.title: Past simple javoblari
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: yesterday I bought a book. She didn’t come to class, “come” asosiy shaklda qoladi. Did you see the film, “see” ham asosiy shaklda. Agar birinchi gapda “buyed” degan bo‘lsangiz, esda tuting: buy noto‘g‘ri fe’l, uning o‘tgan shakli bought.
scenes.say: I bought a book. She didn't come. Did you see the film?
scenes.say_uz: Men kitob sotib oldim. U kelmadi. Filmni ko‘rdingizmi?

scenes.title: Takrorlash: kelasi zamon
board: be going to + V1: reja, dalil

examples.t: I'll help you with the bags.

scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi takrorlash: kelasi zamon. Oldindan qilingan reja uchun “be going to”: I’m going to study medicine. Gap paytida qabul qilingan qaror, va’da yoki taxmin uchun “will”: I’ll help you. Aniq kelishilgan uchrashuv uchun present continuous: I’m meeting Tom at six. Uchalasida ham keyin fe’l asosiy shaklda keladi. O‘zbekchada hammasini “-aman” deymiz, inglizchada tanlash kerak.
scenes.say: I'm going to visit my aunt. I'll call you later. We're meeting at six.
scenes.say_uz: Men xolamnikiga bormoqchiman. Keyinroq qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman. Biz oltida uchrashamiz.

scenes.title: Kelasi zamondagi xatolar
scenes.say_native: Ikkita tipik xato. Birinchi: will dan keyin “to” qo‘yish. To‘g‘risi — I will go. Ikkinchi: if va when dan keyin kelasi zamon uchun will ishlatish. “If it will rain” emas, “if it rains, I’ll stay at home”. Shart gapining if qismida hozirgi zamon ishlatiladi. O‘zbek tilida bunday farq yo‘q, shuning uchun ehtiyot bo‘ling.
scenes.say: I will go. If it rains, I will stay at home.
scenes.say_uz: Men boraman. Agar yomg‘ir yog‘sa, uyda qolaman.

scenes.title: Kelasi zamon mashqi
board: 1) Look at the clouds! It ___ rain.
2) The phone is ringing. I ___ answer it.
3) If we ___ late, we'll miss the bus.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Bo‘sh joylarga to‘g‘ri shakl qo‘ying. Birinchi: bulutlarga qarang, yomg‘ir yog‘adi. Ikkinchi: telefon jiringlayapti, men javob beraman. Uchinchi: agar kech qolsak, avtobusga ulgurmaymiz. Har bir gapda going to, will yoki hozirgi zamonni tanlang.
scenes.say: One. Look at the clouds! It blank rain. Two. The phone is ringing. I blank answer it. Three. If we blank late, we'll miss the bus.
scenes.say_uz: Bir. Bulutlarga qarang! Yomg‘ir yog‘adi. Ikki. Telefon jiringlayapti. Men javob beraman. Uch. Agar kech qolsak, avtobusga ulgurmaymiz.

scenes.title: Kelasi zamon javoblari
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi — is going to rain, chunki bulutlar dalil. Ikkinchi — I’ll answer it, qaror gap paytida qabul qilindi. Uchinchi — if we are late, bu yerda will emas, oddiy hozirgi zamon. Uchalasini topgan bo‘lsangiz, kelasi zamon bo‘limi tayyor.
scenes.say: It is going to rain. I'll answer it. If we are late.
scenes.say_uz: Yomg‘ir yog‘adi. Men javob beraman. Agar kech qolsak.

scenes.title: Takrorlash: taqqoslash
board: long: expensive → more expensive → the most expensive
good → better → the best, bad → worse → the worst

examples.t: My flat is smaller than yours.

scenes.say_native: Uchinchi takrorlash: sifatlarni taqqoslash. Qisqa sifatga er qo‘shamiz: taller. Y bilan tugasa, y i ga aylanadi: easier. Uzun sifat oldiga more qo‘yamiz: more expensive. Eng yuqori daraja uchun the va est yoki the most. Noto‘g‘ri shakllar: good — better — best, bad — worse — worst. Taqqoslashda “than” ishlatiladi, “then” emas. “Then” keyin degani.
scenes.say: Taller than. Easier than. More expensive than. The best. The worst.
scenes.say_uz: Dan balandroq. Dan osonroq. Dan qimmatroq. Eng yaxshi. Eng yomon.

scenes.title: Taqqoslashdagi xatolar
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchi: ikki marta taqqoslash, “more taller”. Faqat bittasi kerak: taller. Ikkinchi: qisqa sifat bilan most ishlatish, “the most easy” emas, “the easiest”. Uchinchi: than o‘rniga then yozish. Than — dan, then — keyin. Va yana: eng yuqori darajada the unutilmasin: the best, the cheapest.
scenes.say: Taller, not more taller. The easiest. Taller than me.
scenes.say_uz: Taller, more taller emas. Eng oson. Mendan balandroq.

scenes.title: Taqqoslash mashqi
board: 1) This bag is ___ (cheap) than that one.
2) It's the ___ (good) film of the year.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Qavs ichidagi so‘zni to‘g‘ri darajaga qo‘ying. Bu sumka u sumkadan arzonroq. Bu yilning eng yaxshi filmi. Bugun kechagidan issiqroq. Oltin kumushdan qimmatroq. Ehtiyot bo‘ling: hot da undosh ikkilanadi.
scenes.say: One. This bag is blank cheap than that one. Two. It's the blank good film of the year. Three. Today is blank hot than yesterday. Four. Gold is blank expensive than silver.
scenes.say_uz: Bir. Bu sumka u sumkadan arzonroq. Ikki. Bu yilning eng yaxshi filmi. Uch. Bugun kechagidan issiqroq. To‘rt. Oltin kumushdan qimmatroq.

scenes.title: Taqqoslash javoblari
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: cheaper, the best, hotter, more expensive. Hotter da t ikkita, chunki so‘z bir bo‘g‘inli va undosh bilan tugaydi. Expensive uzun sifat, shuning uchun more. Ko‘rdingizmi, qoida bir xil, faqat qaysi guruhga tegishli ekanini aniqlash kerak.
scenes.say: Cheaper. The best. Hotter. More expensive.
scenes.say_uz: Arzonroq. Eng yaxshi. Issiqroq. Qimmatroq.

scenes.title: Takrorlash: present perfect

examples.t: I have lived here for five years.
examples.uz: Men bu yerda besh yildan beri yashayman.

scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi takrorlash: present perfect. Shakli have yoki has va uchinchi shakl. Ikki asosiy ishlatilishi bor. Birinchisi: hayotiy tajriba, ever va never bilan. Ikkinchisi: hozirgacha davom etayotgan holat, for va since bilan. For — muddat: for five years. Since — boshlanish nuqtasi: since 2020. Already va just ham tez-tez uchraydi: she has already left. Aniq vaqt, yesterday kabi so‘zlar bilan esa past simple.
scenes.say: Have you ever been to London? I have lived here for five years. She has already left.
scenes.say_uz: Londonda bo‘lganmisiz? Men bu yerda besh yildan beri yashayman. U allaqachon ketgan.

scenes.title: Present perfect mashqi
board: 4) He has worked here ___ three years.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Birinchi: men bu yerda 2019-yildan beri yashayman, since yoki for. Ikkinchi: u hech qachon sushi yemagan. Uchinchi: biz o‘tgan dushanba kuni uchrashdik. To‘rtinchi: u bu yerda uch yildan beri ishlaydi, for yoki since. Zamonni vaqt so‘zidan aniqlang.
scenes.say: One. I live here blank 2019. Two. She never eat sushi. Three. We meet last Monday. Four. He has worked here blank three years.
scenes.say_uz: Bir. Men bu yerda 2019-yildan beri yashayman. Ikki. U hech qachon sushi yemagan. Uch. Biz o‘tgan dushanba uchrashdik. To‘rt. U bu yerda uch yildan beri ishlaydi.

scenes.title: Present perfect javoblari
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: I have lived here since 2019. She has never eaten sushi. We met last Monday, bu yerda present perfect emas, chunki last Monday aniq vaqt. Va he has worked here for three years. Muhim qoida: since bilan nuqta, for bilan muddat.
scenes.say: I have lived here since 2019. She has never eaten sushi. We met last Monday. For three years.
scenes.say_uz: Men bu yerda 2019-yildan beri yashayman. U hech qachon sushi yemagan. Biz o‘tgan dushanba uchrashdik. Uch yildan beri.

scenes.title: Qisqa grammatika imtihon topshirig‘i
scenes.say_native: Grammatika qismida odatda gap beriladi, bitta so‘z tushirib qoldirilgan va uchta-to‘rtta variant bor. Strategiya: birinchi, gapni oxirigacha o‘qing. Ikkinchi, vaqt so‘zlarini qidiring: yesterday, tomorrow, ever, since. Uchinchi, aniq noto‘g‘ri variantlarni o‘chiring. Qolgan ikkitadan ma’noga mosini tanlang. Bo‘sh qoldirmang.
scenes.say: Read the whole sentence. Look for time words. Remove wrong answers.
scenes.say_uz: Gapni to‘liq o‘qing. Vaqt so‘zlarini qidiring. Noto‘g‘ri javoblarni o‘chiring.

scenes.title: Mini grammatika sinovi
board: 1) She ___ to Paris last year. (go / went / has gone)
2) I have never ___ a horse. (ride / rode / ridden)
3) Tomorrow I ___ my friend. (meet / am meeting / met)
4) Your car is ___ than mine. (fast / faster / fastest)
scenes.say_native: Sinov. Har bir gapda to‘g‘ri variantni tanlang. Birinchi: o‘tgan yili u Parijga bordi. Ikkinchi: men hech qachon otga minmaganman. Uchinchi: ertaga do‘stim bilan uchrashaman. To‘rtinchi: sizning mashinangiz meniknidan tezroq. Vaqt so‘zlarini qidiring.
scenes.say: One. She went, go, or has gone to Paris last year? Two. I have never ride, rode, or ridden a horse? Three. Tomorrow I meet, am meeting, or met my friend? Four. Your car is fast, faster, or fastest than mine?
scenes.say_uz: Bir. U o‘tgan yili Parijga bordi. Ikki. Men hech qachon otga minmaganman. Uch. Ertaga do‘stim bilan uchrashaman. To‘rt. Mashinangiz meniknidan tezroq.

scenes.title: Grammatika sinovi javoblari
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: went, chunki last year aniq vaqt. Ridden, have never dan keyin uchinchi shakl. Am meeting, ertaga uchun kelishilgan reja. Faster, than bilan qiyosiy daraja. To‘rttasini topgan bo‘lsangiz, grammatikangiz A2 darajasiga mos.
scenes.say: Went. Ridden. Am meeting. Faster.
scenes.say_uz: Went. Ridden. Am meeting. Faster.

scenes.title: Lug‘at: asosiy mavzular
scenes.say_native: Lug‘at qismi uchun mavzular bo‘yicha takrorlash eng yaxshi usul. Oila, uy, ovqat, xarid, sayohat, salomatlik, ish, bo‘sh vaqt, ob-havo, kiyim va texnologiya. Har bir mavzudan o‘nta so‘zni daftarga yozing va so‘zni gap ichida yodlang. Yolg‘iz so‘z tez unutiladi, gap ichidagi so‘z esa esda qoladi. Kollokatsiyalarga e’tibor bering: make a mistake, do homework, take a photo.
scenes.say: Learn words in sentences. Make a mistake. Do homework. Take a photo.
scenes.say_uz: So‘zlarni gap ichida o‘rganing. Xato qilmoq. Uy vazifasini bajarmoq. Rasmga olmoq.

scenes.title: Make va do
scenes.say_native: Make va do — o‘zbek tilida ikkalasi ko‘pincha “qilmoq”, shuning uchun adashadi. Make — yaratish natijasi: make a mistake, make a cake, make a phone call. Do — faoliyat yoki vazifa: do homework, do the dishes, do exercise. Bular iboralar, ularni butun holda yodlash kerak. “I did a mistake” emas, “I made a mistake”.
scenes.say: I made a mistake. She did her homework. We made a cake.
scenes.say_uz: Men xato qildim. U uy vazifasini bajardi. Biz tort pishirdik.

scenes.title: Lug‘at sinovi
board: 1) I ___ a mistake in the test.
3) Let's ___ a cake for the party.
scenes.say_native: Sinov. Make yoki do ni tanlang. Birinchi: men testda xato qildim. Ikkinchi: menga yordam bera olasizmi, ya’ni ma’qul ish qila olasizmi. Uchinchi: bayram uchun tort pishiraylik. To‘rtinchi: u har kuni idish yuvadi. Uchinchi va ikkinchi gapga ehtiyot bo‘ling.
scenes.say: One. I blank a mistake in the test. Two. Can you blank me a favour? Three. Let's blank a cake. Four. He blank the washing-up every day.
scenes.say_uz: Bir. Men testda xato qildim. Ikki. Menga yordam bera olasizmi? Uch. Tort pishiraylik. To‘rt. U har kuni idish yuvadi.

scenes.title: Lug‘at javoblari
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: made a mistake. Do me a favour — yordam so‘rashning odatiy iborasi. Make a cake. Va he does the washing-up, uchinchi shaxs, shuning uchun does. Ikkinchi gapda do ni ishlatganingiz ajoyib: bu iboralarni yodlash kerak.
scenes.say: Made. Do. Make. Does.
scenes.say_uz: Made. Do. Make. Does.

scenes.title: Kundalik vaziyat: do‘konda
board: How much is it? / How much are they?
Do you have it in a bigger size?
scenes.say_native: Endi kundalik vaziyatlar. Do‘konda: “How much is it?” — necha pul? Ko‘plik uchun “How much are they?”. “Can I try it on?” — kiyib ko‘rsam bo‘ladimi? “Do you have it in a bigger size?” — kattaroq o‘lchami bormi? Sotib olishga qaror qilganda: “I’ll take it”. Odob uchun please va thank you ni unutmang. Narxni to‘g‘ri eshitish uchun thirty va thirteen farqini esdan chiqarmang.
scenes.say: How much is this jacket? Can I try it on? Do you have it in a bigger size? I'll take it.
scenes.say_uz: Bu kurtka necha pul? Kiyib ko‘rsam bo‘ladimi? Kattaroq o‘lchami bormi? Men buni olaman.

scenes.title: Kundalik vaziyat: restoran va yo‘l
board: Could we have the bill, please?
Excuse me, how do I get to ...?
Turn left / right, go straight on

examples.t: Go straight on, then turn left.

scenes.say_native: Restoranda buyurtma: “I’d like a coffee, please”, bu “I want” dan ancha muloyim. Hisob so‘rash: “Could we have the bill, please?” Yo‘l so‘rash: “Excuse me, how do I get to the station?” Javob: “Go straight on, then turn left”. Muloyim so‘rov uchun could va would ishlating. “I want” juda to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri eshitiladi.
scenes.say: I'd like a tea, please. Could we have the bill? How do I get to the station?
scenes.say_uz: Menga choy bering. Hisobni olib kelsangiz? Bekatga qanday boraman?

scenes.title: Dialog: do‘konda
board: Customer: Yes, I'd like to try this jumper in medium.
Assistant: Here you are. The changing room is on your left.
Customer: It's too big. Do you have a small?
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tinglash dialogi. Mijoz kofta kiyib ko‘ryapti. Qaysi o‘lcham dastlab so‘ralganini, nima uchun almashtirilganini va narx qancha ekanini aniqlang. Savollarni tinglagandan keyin beraman.
scenes.say: Can I help you? Yes, I'd like to try this jumper in medium. Here you are. The changing room is on your left. It's too big. Do you have a small? Yes. That's twenty-five pounds. I'll take it.
scenes.say_uz: Yordam bera olamanmi? Ha, bu koftani o‘rtacha o‘lchamda kiyib ko‘rmoqchiman. Marhamat. Kiyinish xonasi chap tomonda. U juda katta. Kichigi bormi? Ha. Bu yigirma besh funt. Men buni olaman.

scenes.title: Dialog savollari
board: 1) Which size did the customer try first?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol. Mijoz avval qaysi o‘lchamni kiyib ko‘rdi? Nega almashtirdi? Kofta necha pul? Kiyinish xonasi qayerda? Eshitganingizni eslab, qisqa javob bering.
scenes.say: Which size first? Why does he change it? How much is it? Where is the changing room?
scenes.say_uz: Avval qaysi o‘lcham? Nega almashtiradi? Necha pul? Kiyinish xonasi qayerda?

scenes.title: Dialog javoblari
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: o‘rtacha, medium. U juda katta, too big, shuning uchun kichigini so‘radi. Narxi yigirma besh funt, twenty-five, ty bilan tugaydi, ya’ni 25. Kiyinish xonasi chap tomonda, on your left. Ko‘rdingizmi, kalit ma’lumotlar sizga tanish raqamlar va oddiy so‘zlar edi.
scenes.say: Medium. Too big. Twenty-five pounds. On the left.
scenes.say_uz: O‘rtacha. Juda katta. Yigirma besh funt. Chap tomonda.

scenes.title: O‘qish: qisqa matn va xabar
board: Find the key word in the text
scenes.say_native: O‘qish qismida qisqa matnlar bo‘ladi: xabar, e’lon, elektron xat, jadval. Strategiya: avval savolni o‘qing, so‘ng matndan shu so‘zni qidiring. Bu skanerlash, ya’ni skimming emas, scanning deyiladi. Javobni faqat matndan oling, o‘z bilimingizdan emas. Savol so‘zlari matnda boshqa so‘z bilan almashtirilgan bo‘lishi mumkin: “cheap” o‘rniga “low price”. Shuni kuzatib boring.
scenes.say: Read the question. Find the key word. Answer from the text.
scenes.say_uz: Savolni o‘qing. Kalit so‘zni toping. Matndan javob bering.

scenes.title: O‘qish sinovi
board: Hi Sam! The party is on Saturday at 7 p.m. at my house, 14 Park Road. Please bring a dessert. Can you tell Leila? Thanks, Tina
3) What should Sam do for Tina?
scenes.say_native: Xabarni o‘qing. Tina Samga yozgan. Savollar: bayram qachon? Sam nima olib kelishi kerak? Sam Tina uchun yana nima qilishi kerak? Matnni o‘qib, javob bering.
scenes.say: Hi Sam! The party is on Saturday at seven p.m. at my house, fourteen Park Road. Please bring a dessert. Can you tell Leila? Thanks, Tina.
scenes.say_uz: Salom Sam! Bayram shanba kuni kechqurun soat yettida mening uyimda, Park Road 14. Iltimos, shirinlik olib kel. Leylaga aytib qo‘ya olasanmi? Rahmat, Tina.

scenes.title: O‘qish javoblari
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: shanba kuni, kechki yettida. Shirinlik, dessert. Leylaga aytish, tell Leila. “Can you tell Leila” — bu iltimos, uni “Leyla kelyaptimi” deb noto‘g‘ri tushunmang. Qisqa xabarlarda iltimos ko‘pincha “Can you...?” yoki “Could you...?” bilan beriladi.
scenes.say: Saturday at seven. A dessert. Tell Leila.
scenes.say_uz: Shanba kuni yettida. Shirinlik. Leylaga ayting.

scenes.title: Xabar yozish: tuzilma
board: Greeting: Hi Sam, / Dear Mr Smith,
Ending: See you soon, / Best wishes, + ism

examples.t: I'm writing to invite you to my party.
examples.uz: Sizni bayramga taklif qilish uchun yozyapman.

scenes.say_native: Yozish qismida odatda qisqa xabar yoki elektron xat yoziladi, taxminan o‘ttiz-ellik so‘z. Tuzilma: salom, sabab, tafsilotlar, xayrlashuv. Do‘stga: “Hi Sam” va “See you soon”. Rasmiyroq: “Dear Mr Smith” va “Best wishes”. “I’m writing to ...” — sabab bildirish uchun foydali ibora. Savolda aytilgan barcha nuqtalarni qamrab oling, bu ball uchun eng muhim narsa.
scenes.say: Hi Sam, I'm writing to invite you. It is on Saturday. See you soon!
scenes.say_uz: Salom Sam, seni taklif qilish uchun yozyapman. Bu shanba kuni. Ko‘rishguncha!

scenes.title: Yozishdagi xatolar
scenes.say_native: Yozishda ko‘p uchraydigan xatolar. Birinchi: “I” harfini kichik yozish. Inglizchada I har doim bosh harf. Ikkinchi: gap boshi va nuqtani unutish. Uchinchi: vaqtni adashtirish, kecha haqida yozsangiz past simple. Va to‘rtinchi: “am write” kabi aralash shakl, to‘g‘risi “am writing”. Yozib bo‘lgach, bir marta tekshirib chiqing: bosh harf, nuqta, zamon, fe’l shakli.
scenes.say: I went yesterday. I am writing to you. Check capital letters and full stops.
scenes.say_uz: Men kecha bordim. Sizga yozyapman. Bosh harf va nuqtalarni tekshiring.

scenes.title: Yozish topshirig‘i
board: - invite him to dinner on Friday
- ask him to bring a drink
scenes.say_native: Yozish topshirig‘i. Do‘stingizga qisqa xabar yozing, o‘ttiz-qirq so‘z. Uni juma kuni kechki ovqatga taklif qiling, qayerda ekanini ayting va ichimlik olib kelishini so‘rang. Daftarga yozing va to‘xtatib turing.
scenes.say: Write a short message. Invite your friend to dinner on Friday. Say where. Ask him to bring a drink.
scenes.say_uz: Qisqa xabar yozing. Do‘stingizni juma kuni kechki ovqatga taklif qiling. Qayerda ekanini ayting. Ichimlik olib kelishini so‘rang.

scenes.title: Yozish namunasi
board: I'm writing to invite you to dinner on Friday at 7 p.m. at my flat, 5 Green Street.
Could you bring a drink? See you soon! Aziz
scenes.say_native: Namuna: Hi Daniel, I’m writing to invite you to dinner on Friday at seven p.m. at my flat, five Green Street. Could you bring a drink? See you soon, Aziz. Barcha uchta nuqta bor: taklif, joy, iltimos. Sizniki boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, yetarli bo‘lgani — uchala nuqtani yozgan va to‘g‘ri zamondan foydalangan bo‘lsangiz.
scenes.say: Hi Daniel, I'm writing to invite you to dinner on Friday at seven at my flat. Could you bring a drink? See you soon!
scenes.say_uz: Salom Daniel, seni juma kuni soat yettida kvartiramda kechki ovqatga taklif qilish uchun yozyapman. Ichimlik olib kela olasanmi? Ko‘rishguncha!

scenes.title: Gapirish qismi
scenes.say_native: Gapirish qismi odatda uch bosqichdan iborat. Birinchi: o‘zingiz haqingizda savollar, oila, ish, bo‘sh vaqt. Ikkinchi: rasm yoki mavzu haqida bir daqiqa gapirish. Uchinchi: imtihon oluvchi bilan qisqa suhbat. Hech narsani tushunmasangiz: “Sorry, could you repeat that?” deb so‘rang. Bu normal va hech qanday ball ayirilmaydi. Va to‘liq gap bilan javob bering, bir so‘zli javob yetarli emas.
scenes.say: Sorry, could you repeat that, please? Answer in full sentences.
scenes.say_uz: Kechirasiz, takrorlay olasizmi? To‘liq gap bilan javob bering.

scenes.title: Hikoya tuzish: bir haftangiz haqida

examples.t: First, I went to work. After that, I met my friend.
examples.uz: Avval ishga bordim. Keyin do‘stim bilan uchrashdim.

scenes.say_native: Bir daqiqalik hikoya uchun oddiy reja bor. Bog‘lovchilar: first, then, after that, in the end. Hamma fe’l past simpleda. Oxirida o‘z fikringizni qo‘shing: it was great, I was tired. Misol: “Last week was busy. First, I worked on Monday. Then I visited my aunt. In the end, I was tired but happy.” Bunday reja sizni to‘xtab qolishdan saqlaydi.
scenes.say: Last week was busy. First, I worked. Then I visited my aunt. In the end, I was tired but happy.
scenes.say_uz: O‘tgan hafta band edi. Avval ishladim. Keyin xolamnikiga bordim. Oxirida charchadim, lekin xursand edim.

scenes.title: Hikoya: bir daqiqa
board: Tell the story of your week:
First ... Then ... After that ... In the end ...
Use past simple + one present perfect
scenes.say_native: Endi sinab ko‘ring. O‘tgan haftangiz haqida bir daqiqa gapiring. First, then, after that, in the end dan foydalaning. Ko‘pchilik fe’llar past simpleda bo‘lsin, bitta present perfect gap qo‘shing, masalan “I have never been so tired”. Baland ovozda gapiring.
scenes.say: Tell me about your week. First, then, after that, in the end.
scenes.say_uz: Haftangiz haqida gapiring. Avval, keyin, undan keyin, oxirida.

scenes.title: Gapirish namunasi
board: First, I worked on Monday and Tuesday.
In the end, I have never been so tired!
scenes.say_native: Namuna: First, I worked on Monday and Tuesday. Then I visited my aunt on Thursday. After that, I watched a film with my friends. In the end, I was very tired, I have never been so tired. Sizning hikoyangiz boshqacha bo‘lishi kerak. Muhim: bog‘lovchilar bor, past simple to‘g‘ri, bir daqiqa davomida to‘xtab qolmadingiz. Shu darajaga yetgan bo‘lsangiz, A2 gapirish uchun tayyorsiz.
scenes.say: First, I worked on Monday. Then I visited my aunt. In the end, I was tired but happy.
scenes.say_uz: Avval dushanba kuni ishladim. Keyin xolamnikiga bordim. Oxirida charchadim, lekin xursand edim.

scenes.title: Imtihon kuni maslahatlari
scenes.say_native: Imtihon kuni uchun maslahatlar. Birinchi: vaqtni bo‘ling. Qiyin savolda tiqilib qolsangiz, o‘tib keting va oxirida qaytib keling. Ikkinchi: oxirgi besh daqiqani javoblarni tekshirishga ajrating: imlo, bosh harf, fe’l shakli. Uchinchi: yaxshi uxlang va ertalab ovqatlaning. To‘rtinchi: hovliqmang, siz bu mavzularning hammasini o‘rgandingiz. A2 darajasi sizga mos.
scenes.say: Manage your time. Check your answers. Stay calm. You are ready.
scenes.say_uz: Vaqtni boshqaring. Javoblarni tekshiring. Xotirjam bo‘ling. Siz tayyorsiz.

scenes.title: Daraja xulosasi
board: Present perfect: ever, never, for, since
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Bu darajada siz o‘tgan zamonni, kelasi zamonning uchta shaklini, taqqoslashni va present perfectni o‘rgandingiz. Do‘konda, restoranda va yo‘lda muloqot qila olasiz. Qisqa xabar yozasiz va e’londan ma’lumot ajratib olasiz. Imtihonda esa savolni diqqat bilan o‘qing, vaqtni bo‘ling va tekshirib chiqing. Tabriklayman, siz A2 darajasini tugatyapsiz.
scenes.say: You have finished A2. Congratulations! You can talk about the past, the future and your experiences.
scenes.say_uz: Siz A2 ni tugatdingiz. Tabriklayman! O‘tmish, kelajak va tajribalaringiz haqida gapira olasiz.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Tell a 1-minute story about your week
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: A2 imtihon testini ishlang va bir daqiqalik hikoyani telefonga yozib oling: o‘tgan haftangiz haqida. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: testda kamida o‘n ikkita to‘g‘ri javob va hikoyada kamida to‘rtta bog‘lovchi, ya’ni first, then, after that, in the end. Keyingi darsda B1 darajasini boshlaymiz va zamonlar tizimini umumiy takrorlaymiz, shuning uchun yangi bosqichga tayyorlaning.
scenes.say: Do the exam test. Record your one-minute story. Good luck!
scenes.say_uz: Imtihon testini ishlang. Bir daqiqalik hikoyangizni yozib oling. Omad!

homework_uz: A2 imtihon testini ishlang va o‘tgan haftangiz haqida bir daqiqalik hikoyani yozib oling. Testda kamida 12 ta to‘g‘ri javob bo‘lsin, hikoyada kamida to‘rtta bog‘lovchi (first, then, after that, in the end) bo‘lsin.

quiz.why_uz: Yesterday — aniq vaqt, past simple: went.
Did dan keyin fe’l asosiy shaklda: know.

quiz.q: Look at those clouds! It ___ rain.
If it ___ tomorrow, we'll stay at home.
quiz.why_uz: If dan keyin kelasi zamon uchun hozirgi zamon ishlatiladi.

quiz.q: This phone is ___ than that one.

options: I have seen him last week.
I have saw him last week.
quiz.why_uz: Last week aniq vaqt, past simple.
Make a mistake, do homework, make a cake.

quiz.q: 'It's at three... sorry, four.' The time is:
Which is the best way to start a message to a friend?
